Our Story

A Crew Born to Preserve & Elevate Culture

Founded in 2009, Ethiopiawinet Dance Crew has grown into one of Ethiopia's most celebrated performing arts groups. We are six artists united by a shared mission: to keep the living traditions of our heritage vibrant, visible, and celebrated.

From winning the prestigious Balgeru Idol to performing alongside Ethiopia's most popular singers in music videos, Ethiopiawinet has become a defining voice in East African cultural performance.

Deeply grounded in the rich traditions of Ethiopia and Eritrea — we bring authenticity, precision, and soul to every stage we grace.

DanceEthiopian & Eritrean traditional forms
MusicLive drumming & traditional song
TheatreStorytelling through movement
ReachNational & international stages

What We Do

The Art We Bring to Life

Every Ethiopiawinet performance is a complete cultural experience — weaving together movement, sound, story, and spirit drawn from centuries of East African tradition.

💃

Traditional Dance

Authentic choreography from diverse Ethiopian and Eritrean regional traditions, performed with precision and cultural integrity.

🥁

Live Drumming

Powerful percussion rooted in Ethiopian rhythmic tradition, setting the heartbeat of every performance.

🎶

Traditional Song

Vocal performances drawing from Ethiopia's rich musical heritage, sung with deep cultural meaning.

🎭

Cultural Theatre

Narrative performance blending dance, music, and dramatic storytelling to bring Ethiopian history and folklore to life.
